title: TextEDA IR v0.19 — schematic shard
description: Project schematic IR: the one logical root of a project. It composes module descriptions from design/modules/; all component instances and electrical facts belong to modules, and the root has no component instances of its own. The IR stays flat for ordinary consumers: instances/nets/ports carry flattened names (<module_instance_id>.<local_id>), while the modules segment carries the module-instance ownership and module-port records needed to validate physical assignments and interconnect endpoints. Equal local net names in separate module instances never merge by themselves: a flattened project net exists only through the root's nets segment, and net-name equality never supplies a physical interconnect (ADR-0069 D1/D3). Source: design/sch/main.teda. See ADR-0069, ADR-0012, ADR-0006 decision 5.

format.description: Language version of the .teda file that produced this shard.

source.description: Source-file location: path relative to the project root plus an optional line number. For the root this is design/sch/main.teda.

project.description: Project-level logical root identity. design/sch/main.teda is the only logical root; there are no board-local schematic files and no system descriptions (ADR-0069 D1).

modules.description: The root's module instances in declaration order. Module-instance identities are owned here and are globally unique within the project; the same module definition may be instantiated many times. Flattened instance and internal-net names remain <module_instance_id>.<local_id>. Rows retain the module's ports and their component pin refs so endpoint mappings can be validated without inferring ownership.

instances.description: All component instances of the project, flattened from the module descriptions: an instance inside a module instance carries the module prefix (M1.U1). The root itself declares no components.

nets.description: All project nets. A flattened project net merges the module ports listed here; equal local net names in separate module instances never merge by themselves.

ports.description: Project-level ports of the logical root, connecting to external interfaces.

buses.description: Bus definition, declaring a group of project nets as one bus.

constraints.description: Root constraints are project-wide; module constraints flatten onto their module-local or root-bound net as before (ADR-0069 D1).

interconnects.description: Explicit cross-PCB connections between module-port endpoints, separate from nets and copper (ADR-0069 D3). Both endpoints of one interconnect must belong to the same root project net and be implemented by different PCBs. Equal net names never imply an interconnect: these facts are declared, not inferred.

interconnect_pins.description: Optional terminal mapping for connector or cable conductors (ADR-0069 D3). Each row names an interconnect and one pin on each endpoint module; each pin must belong to that endpoint port's module-local net. One interconnect may have multiple pin-pair rows. Omitted entirely when no connector/cable terminal mapping is modeled — the interconnect still explicitly declares the port-to-port path.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute.

instance_id.description: Module-instance identity owned by the root and globally unique within the project, shape M1, M2, … (spec/module.md §5); the prefix of every flattened instance/net name of this instance (M1.U1, M1.VFB). Reused module definitions keep per-instance identities.

module_id.description: The module definition composed from design/modules/<module_id>.teda; project-local and possibly instantiated more than once.

uid.description: Stable module-instance identity (ADR-0010): ID plus six lowercase Crockford Base32 characters.

ports.description: The module instance's ports as declared by its definition, retained so interconnect endpoints and pin mappings can be resolved without inferring ownership. Port nets are the module-local nets before root net merging.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute.

id.description: Port name, the name visible outside the module; the local part of an interconnect endpoint <module_instance_id>.<port>.

net.description: Module-local net the port connects to, before root net merging; omitted for an unconnected port.

pins.description: Full normalized flattened component pin refs belonging to this port's module-local net, e.g. M1.U1.4 — the component pins this port presents.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute.

uid.description: Stable instance identity (ADR-0010): ID plus six lowercase Crockford Base32 characters. A module-local instance is qualified by its module instance uid, e.g. IDp8x2n4/IDk2m8q4. Absent in pre-0.9 files.

id.description: Flattened display name of the project's flat instance list: U1, or M1.U1 for an instance inside module instance M1. It remains the key used by net members and placements; the stable identity is `uid` (ADR-0010).

component.description: Device reference (component_id), bare: every device the project reads is its own file under assets/components/ (ADR-0034).

params.description: Ordered as declared in the component's params section; optional columns may be omitted.

dnp.description: Whether it is not placed (unmounted but occupies a spot).

logical_only.description: E.g. power flags: exist only at the logical layer and produce no physical entity.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute.

id.description: The net name is the identity key: GND, VFB, or a module-qualified flattened name (M1.VFB).

members.description: Flattened pin references of the project net, in numbered form (M1.U1.4). A single-member net is legal but draws an ERC warning.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute.

id.description: Project port name, the name visible outside the project.

net.description: Project net name the port connects to (net_id).

id.description: Bus name, unique within the project.

type.description: As of v0.4 this is only a naming convention; no protocol validation is performed.

nets.description: List of project net names the bus contains.

endpoint_ref.description: Interconnect endpoint: <module_instance_id>.<port>, e.g. M1.PORT. The port must be declared by that module instance's ports segment.

pin_endpoint_ref.description: Pin endpoint of an interconnect_pin row: <module_instance_id>.<instance_id>.<pin_number>, e.g. M1.J1.1 — a component pin of the endpoint module instance; each pin must belong to that endpoint port's module-local net.

id.description: Interconnect identity, unique within the project; views reference it by this ID and can neither create nor remove the fact.

from.description: One endpoint as <module_instance_id>.<port>. Both endpoints must belong to the same root project net and be implemented by different PCBs (ADR-0069 D2/D3).

to.description: The other endpoint as <module_instance_id>.<port>. Equal net names on separate PCBs do not supply this fact; it is declared here, never inferred.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute.

interconnect.description: The interconnect id this pin pair maps; one interconnect may have multiple rows.

from.description: Connector/cable terminal on the `from` side: <module_instance_id>.<instance_id>.<pin_number>, e.g. M1.J1.1. The pin must belong to the endpoint port's module-local net.

to.description: Connector/cable terminal on the `to` side: <module_instance_id>.<instance_id>.<pin_number>, e.g. M2.J1.1. The pin must belong to the endpoint port's module-local net.

net_or_pin_ref.description: The subject can be a net (flattened name) or a pin reference; the two share the same shape and the parser resolves ambiguity by context.
